capabilityDetails.name: Building and versioning Policy Plus
capabilityDetails.purpose: Stamp the program with its current Git version when it is built.

capabilityDetails.name: Getting Microsoft policy definitions
capabilityDetails.purpose: Download Microsoft's current policy template package and unpack it into a folder the program can read.

capabilityDetails.name: Using the product
capabilityDetails.purpose: Product's own settings, such as the language of the policy text.

capabilityDetails.name: Choosing and saving policy sources
capabilityDetails.purpose: Pick where the user and computer policies are kept (POL file, registry, a user's registry hive, a user's Group Policy object, or the live system) and save changes back to them.

capabilityDetails.name: Changing policy settings
capabilityDetails.purpose: Set a policy to Enabled, Disabled or Not configured with its options and comment, and move settings in or out as SPOL text.

capabilityDetails.name: Finding policies
capabilityDetails.purpose: Narrow the policy list by filter and find policies by ID, text or registry key and value, then pick a result.

capabilityDetails.name: Editing policy files directly
capabilityDetails.purpose: Change the raw keys and values of a policy file, and bring registry files in or out of it.

capabilityDetails.name: Browsing policy definitions
capabilityDetails.purpose: Look through the loaded policy templates: categories, products, support rules, template files and policies, and open the details of each.
